feedback.finish: People have been trading together around the world for thousands of years.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: When people trade, they exchange something for another item, service or money. Goods that are often traded include food, technology and raw materials.

hint.text: Raw materials are resources found naturally on Earth, such as oil, coal, gas and wood.
hint.label: Raw materials

atoms.text: Countries buy items from each other for many reasons. This is known as importing.
Countries also sell goods to other countries around the world. This is known as exporting.

atoms.a: Which of these are examples of commonly traded goods?
What word is used to describe a country buying goods from another country?
What word is used to describe a country selling goods to another country?

instruction.text: Why do countries trade? Fill in the gaps.

hint.text: This map shows what different areas of Europe are famous for exporting.

atoms.b: Countries trade with each other for a number of reasons. Usually the goal is to make ((++money sunlight)) or to buy cheaper or better quality goods.
They may also want to get goods that they don’t have in their own country, such as oil, wood or certain ((++foods oxygen)).
When countries trade with one another, they are able to build partnerships and form ((weaker ++stronger)) connections.

instruction.text: Not all trade involves physical objects. Read the description of each service and select the matching image.

hint.text: Skilled workers and experts can sell their services around the world. This is known as a service industry.
hint.label: Service

atoms.a: helping people spend, save and organise their money

instruction.text: Why is trade important? Drag and match the text to the correct image.
